title: Lap 4 finale: a tour of everything
idea: LOOP finale: interleave print, arithmetic, strings, conditions, loops, and every list tool from Laps 0-4. Review-heavy wrap.

exercises.explanation: The computer evaluates 2 + 3 first, then prints 5. Numbers aren't shown as text unless quoted.
+ joins strings with nothing between, so "a" + "b" is "ab".
5 > 3 is True AND 5 < 10 is True, so 'and' is True and it prints yes.
range(1, 4) starts at 1 and stops before 4, giving 1, 2, 3.
Only 5 and 9 exceed 4, so out is [5, 9]. Filter builds a list of matches.
11 is the largest. Track-the-best finds it.
None of 2, 4, 6 equals 7, so the search answers no (False).

exercises.prompt: Match each Lap-4 tool to a one-word description.
exercises.explanation: Four tools, four jobs: total, keep-matches, present?, and mean with an empty guard. You now own all of them.

exercises.prompt: You've finished Lap 4 — the full list toolkit. What's the next lap about?
options: splitting big problems into named, reusable sub-plans
